due_when.clears_when: BybitConnector.place_market_order and main.BybitExchangeAdapter are deleted (no caller) or resolve the symbol through bybit_connector.market_symbol / an explicit category; or killed with a reason

what: Dead order path on a spot-default client. src/main.py builds BybitExchangeAdapter(BybitConnector) and passes it into run_one_tick/run_pipeline; its only consumer is src/runtime/orders.py::safe_place_order, which has NO caller in src/ (grep 2026-11-04). BybitConnector.place_market_order sends create_market_order(bare symbol) on a ccxt client built defaultType=spot, so if anything revived that path a bare BTCUSDT order would be a SPOT order on a linear-perp account. Live orders go through pybit with explicit category (src/units/accounts/execute.py::_bybit_category) and are unaffected. get_balance (fetch_balance on the spot default) also has no caller. Fix: delete the dead adapter/methods, or resolve the symbol through bybit_connector.market_symbol. Tier 2 (order-path code, even if dead).
